tailored_resume_bullets: Built a production-ready tours and travel management system using Angular, Node.js, Express, and MySQL, taken live for real customer bookings during internship at Sunflower Trip.
Delivered a full-featured Point of Sale (POS) system with an Angular frontend and C#/MS SQL Server backend deployed on Azure for an Australian restaurant client.
Built a full-stack trading platform (Zenvest) using JavaScript, Node.js, Express, and MongoDB, implementing JWT-based authentication and third-party API integration.
Developed DriftGuard, a MERN-stack security control drift detection tool in a hackathon, mapping configuration changes to NIST and GDPR compliance controls.
kit.cover_letter: I am writing to express my interest in the Software Engineer Intern position at Nutrithy Wellness. As an MCA student at PES University with a CGPA of 8.48 and hands-on full-stack development experience, I am eager to contribute to your engineering team. During my recent internship as a Full Stack Developer at Sunflower Trip, I built a production-ready tours and travel management system using Angular, Node.js, Express, and MySQL, which went live for real customer bookings. Additionally, I delivered a POS system for a live business setting using Angular, C#, MS SQL Server, and Azure. My project work includes Zenvest, a full-stack trading platform built with Node.js, Express, and MongoDB featuring JWT authentication and API integration, and DriftGuard, a MERN-stack security control drift detection tool built during a hackathon. I bring strong proficiency in JavaScript-based software development, API integration, and modern web technologies. I am excited about the possibility of contributing to feature development, code improvement, and API integrations while being considered for the PPO opportunity. Thank you for your time and consideration.

screening_answers.why_this_role: The role involves JavaScript-based software development, building features, improving code, and integrating APIs, which directly matches my experience building full-stack applications using Node.js, Express, and Angular during my internships and projects like Zenvest.
screening_answers.why_you: I bring practical full-stack development experience from my internship at Sunflower Trip where I built and deployed production-ready features using Node.js, Express, and Angular, alongside robust project experience such as Zenvest and DriftGuard.
